confirmation.candidate_rule_scoring: Uniform random selection from retained candidates; exact expected accuracy
confirmation.cue_reference: Only clean/independent cues; planted agree/conflict/shortcut rates are not chance controls
confirmation.gate_implication: Required controls cannot be waived; residual failures require corpus-bound G0 review and disclosure

residual_rule_definitions.event_position_N: Nth focal-object event (one-based); use focal initial location if absent
residual_rule_definitions.last_both_observed: Last focal-object event received by both characters, else focal initial location; semantic solver at depth two
residual_rule_definitions.most_mentioned_location: Mode of focal-object event locations; uniform choice among tied modes
residual_rule_definitions.most_mentioned_location_with_initial: Same mode including focal initial location once
residual_rule_definitions.most_mentioned_story_location: Mode over all initial and event locations; inventory adds one of each and cannot alter the modes

last_both_observed.interpretation: Exact intended depth-two update rule; not a chance-level shortcut control
Exact intended depth-two update rule; not a chance-level shortcut control

confirmation.threshold: Two-sided Hoeffding bounds; required joint relation and heldout clean-cue quotas must match exactly
